hero.filename: Gapochka musical group performance - Cherkasy, Ukraine.jpg
hero.caption:
Gapochka musical group performance, Cherkassy, Ukraine

New Sigma 50mm F1.4 DG HSM Art Lens night test shot. Overall it is nice lens, heavy and big but well made. There is no "wow" effect with this lens, but it is quite good. Preferably for indoor photo, and not for bright sunny day, lens is very fast with 1.4-4.0 working apertures. Auto-focus is quick and accurate as in all new sigmas art serie.
